title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-jordan-lee-samira-patel-2026-03-30
content:
Context / purpose:
- Weekly 1:1 to align on top accounts, risk signals, Dedicated enablement, and Q2 GTM priorities.
- Goals: 3 net-new POCs, 2 Dedicated upsells, reduce time-to-POC to 14 days.

Proposed agenda (30m):
1) Quick personal check-in (5m)
   - Jordan: traveling to SF 4/6-4/9 for customer meetings + QBR prep.
   - Me: running churn-risk audit for March accounts.
2) Account highlights / risks (12m)
   - AtlasHealth (HIGH risk)
       * Last touch: 2026-03-12 technical sync (SRE + Infra).
       * Symptom: 95th percentile latency spikes on long-tail sequences; SLA alerts triggered.
       * Impact: expansion on hold; POC stalled.
       * Immediate ask: infra traces + sample payloads to reproduce.
       * ACTION: Jordan to intro Atlas eng TL to our SRE (email + Slack) — due 2026-04-02.
       * ACTION: Samira to open Jira CS-987 and attach incident notes + request traces — due 2026-03-29.
   - BrightRetail (WATCH)
       * Exploring Dedicated migration and pricing; concerned about cost/latency tradeoffs.
       * Sales-ops must approve pilot pricing.
       * ACTION: Samira to share pilot checklist + quickstart guide with Jordan & BrightRetail — due 2026-03-31.
   - NovaBank (HEALTHY)
       * Renewed in Jan; onboarding metrics look green.
       * Upsell: embeddings for fraud prioritization.
       * ACTION: Jordan to propose exploratory DS call and capture use-case details — due 2026-04-08.
3) Enablement / product updates (6m)
   - Dedicated migration guide (draft) available; needs AE pricing examples and identity/onboarding callouts.
       * ACTION: Jordan to review migration guide and annotate pricing scenarios — due 2026-04-05.
   - New observability dashboard rolling out org-wide this week; plan to surface a 1-slide playbook for AEs.
       * ACTION: Samira to pull 3 key metrics for AE playbook and post in #cs-ops — due 2026-03-31.
4) Pipeline & ops (5m)
   - Q2 POC pipeline: 7 active; prioritize top 3 fit: AtlasHealth, BrightRetail, VectorWorks.
   - Median time-to-POC: 18 days; target 14 days. Blockers: infra onboarding, customer identity setup, pilot env quotas.
       * ACTION: Samira + Jordan to draft 1-page onboarding checklist for kickoff — draft due 2026-03-31.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who owns Dedicated pricing exceptions? Confirm with sales-ops (pricing@redwood.ai).
- Need CSM playbook snippet for latency SLA escalations; reference: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/CS-uptime-playbook.
- Legal status for BrightRetail NDA unclear — ask Jordan to check with legal.

Immediate action items (post 1:1):
- Jordan: intro AtlasHealth eng lead to SRE via email + Slack — due 2026-04-02.
- Samira: open Jira CS-987, attach incident notes and request traces — due 2026-03-29.
- Samira: send pilot checklist + quickstart to Jordan & BrightRetail contact — due 2026-03-31.
- Samira & Jordan: draft 1-page onboarding checklist and share in #cs-ops — due 2026-03-31.
- Jordan: annotate migration guide with pricing examples — due 2026-04-05.
- Samira: post 3 observability metrics and 1-slide playbook draft to #cs-ops — due 2026-03-31.

Follow-ups to log after meeting:
- Update AtlasHealth row in churn tracker (add SLA incidents, mitigation steps, owners).
- Attach migration guide comment thread to BrightRetail opportunity in Salesforce.
- Post meeting recap in #cs-weekly with asks for sales-ops and SRE.

Misc brain-dump:
- Upsell angle for NovaBank: embeddings + vector search for transaction prioritization; sync with product on pricing floor for embeddings at scale.
- Consider running a 30m Dedicated migration office hours next Wed for AEs + CSMs.
- Potential checklist item: one-click sample payload generator for customers to reproduce perf issues locally.

Keywords: 1:1, AE enablement, Dedicated migration, POC, SLA, latency, onboarding checklist
